dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins appear symmetrical and smooth without visible bulges or indentations along the water-line interface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light greyish-white median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Sparse, low-frequency darker grey patches distributed along the cervical region and mid-dorsal axis.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the primary baseline skin tone and localized darker pigmented regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple faint, longitudinal, high-contrast linear marks (rake marks) are visible on the dorsal surface trailing the blowhole.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Healed longitudinal linear scarring consistent with rake marks present on the mid-dorsal surface.
